study type: Retrospective analysis of a prospective observational study
exposure: HBV DNA level (≤2 log(10)IU/ml, 2.01-6 log(10)IU/ml, >6 log(10)IU/ml)
finding: Neither positive HBeAg status nor higher HBV DNA level during pregnancy was significantly associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Neither positive HBeAg status nor higher HBV DNA levels during pregnancy were significantly associated with differences in mode of delivery.
gest_age: 28-30 weeks for HBV DNA level measurement
